rawness.title: Cq values only
rawness.meaning: There are no curves to check: only the instrument's Cq values. Efficiency is assumed, not measured, so confidence is capped at Low.

warnings.message: The LightCycler 480 Cp table names standards only (by their concentration); targets are named after the detection channel. Type your other controls in Studio.
